rationale: Primary pickup set to max_load_current_a * load_margin_multiplier (420 * 1.2 = 504 A), the lowest value satisfying load margin and relay secondary range (5.04 A on 100:1 CT). This maximizes fault sensitivity (1800/504 = 3.57 >= 1.5). Time delay set to downstream_time_delay_s + selectivity_margin_s (0.35 + 0.3 = 0.65 s) for minimum coordinating delay within [0, 2] s.
